title: oenothera macrocarpa subsp. incana
intro: Oenothera macrocarpa subsp. incana, commonly known as a variety of Evening Primrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Onagraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate menopausal symptoms, and support cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera macrocarpa subsp. incana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), linoleic acid, and other polyunsaturated fatty acids. The health benefits of this plant are also linked to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
